items.source: This annotation may be used on @EventListener-compliant methods within a Spring test ApplicationContext — for example, on methods in a @Configuration class. A method annotated with this annotation will be invoked as part of the TestExecutionListener.afterTestClass(TestContext) lifecycle.
items.translation: 此注解可用于 Spring 测试 ApplicationContext 中符合 `@EventListener` 规范的方法内——例如，在 `@Configuration` 类中的方法内。带有此注解的方法将作为 TestExecutionListener.afterTestClass(TestContext) 生命周期的一部分被调用。

items.source: Event processing can optionally be made conditional via a SpEL expression — for example, @AfterTestClass("event.testContext.testClass.name matches '.+IntegrationTests'").
items.translation: 事件处理可以通过 SpEL 表达式可选地设置为条件触发——例如，@AfterTestClass("event.testContext.testClass.name matches '.+IntegrationTests'")。

items.source: The EventPublishingTestExecutionListener must be registered in order for this annotation to have an effect — for example, via @TestExecutionListeners. Note, however, that the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener is registered by default.
items.translation: `EventPublishingTestExecutionListener` 必须已注册，此注解才会生效——例如通过@TestExecutionListeners。不过请注意，`EventPublishingTestExecutionListener` 默认情况下已注册。
